headline: 愛丁堡藝穗多齣好戲登場
context: 愛丁堡藝穗節上，喜劇演員巴達維（Omar Badawy）帶來新作《Guided Detour》，講述自己身為英裔埃及穆斯林的身分拉扯。同一時間，舊金山芭蕾舞團在愛丁堡國際藝術節推出《Mere Mortals》，把潘朵拉的盒子神話搬進 AI 時代，由音樂人 Floating Points 操刀配樂。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Pleasance Courtyard, Edinburgh The comic’s unique tale of assimilation and romance-related limbo has a high joke rate and emotional intelligence I want to tell Omar Badawy to take a breath. This debut moves at a frantic, almost dizzying pace, so much so that you could easily miss a few details in a show that zooms in and out of the time he was accidentally caught in the middle of a Tommy Robinson march while en route to a fancy dress party. But with writing this sharp, does it matter? You can see why SNL: UK came calling. The Cambridge-raised Badawy lays out his identity conundrum: he’s an Anglo-Egyptian Muslim who, as a pupil at a Christian school, was teased for his background. Differences surfaced during Nativity plays, where his culturally accurate interpretations of innkeepers and wise men’s assistants weren’t quite what his teachers had in mind. He also knows his well-spoken accent makes it easier to assimilate. Because of all this, Badawy often feels stuck in the middle. Once, a stranger even asked his ethnicity because he wanted to call him his “correct racial slur”. sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Edinburgh Playhouse San Francisco Ballet brings a spectacular collision of dance, music and digital wizardry to the Edinburgh international festival in this bold reimagining of Pandora’s box This is a spectacular show. Literally, it is full of spectacle: as much a visual extravaganza as it is a concert, as it is dance – and a gloriously maddening piece of dance at that. The dancers are as impressive as you’d expect from San Francisco Ballet, the US’s oldest professional ballet company, and the splashy concept is bold: artistic director Tamara Rojo commissioned choreographer Aszure Barton, composer Sam Shepherd (AKA electronic producer Floating Points) and multidisciplinary artists Hamill Industries, their starting point being the myth of Pandora’s box, transposed to the current world of AI technology and what unknowns we might be unleashing. Hamill Industries, who used some AI in their creation process, unleash something transfixing on a giant screen above the stage: morphing, pulsating pixels that look like lava or the surface of the sun. It’s intoxicating, easily dragging attention away from the dancers’ bodies (this may be the whole point – more on this later). Those dancers appear en masse in strict manoeuvres at driving tempo. Are they an army of mortals, gods, automatons or lines of code? Who knows. But they are moulded into large-scale moving images by Barton just as Pandora is moulded from clay in the best bit of integration between the digital and physical worlds, countless hands crafting this first woman out of dust. Barton is a magpie of a choreographer, always unpredictable, classical virtuosity sewn in among countless other ideas in unstoppable phrases. Jennifer Stahl as Pandora is an impressive creation, for sure, and Wei Wang is great: supple, sprightly, puckish. He represents Hope, although you wouldn’t know that without doing a bit of research. Choreographers are not duty-bound to enact a narrative; the Pandora tale is merely a creative trigger, they’d say, but in a story with such clear dramatic beats, and such a clever contemporary parallel, it does seem a waste to essentially throw that away. thread_text: 愛丁堡藝穗節熱鬧滾滾。喜劇演員巴達維（Omar Badawy）帶來新作《Guided Detour》，用高密度的笑點講自己身為英裔埃及穆斯林、在基督教學校長大的身分拉扯。另一頭，舊金山芭蕾舞團在愛丁堡國際藝術節端出《Mere Mortals》，把潘朵拉的盒子神話搬進 AI 時代，音樂人 Floating Points 親自操刀配樂。本則整理自《衛報》與《紐約時報》報導。
threads_text: 愛丁堡藝穗節今年精彩紛呈。喜劇演員巴達維（Omar Badawy）帶來新作《Guided Detour》，用密集的笑點講自己身為英裔埃及穆斯林、在基督教學校長大的身分拉扯，連《周六夜現場》英國版都注意到他。同一段時間，舊金山芭蕾舞團在愛丁堡國際藝術節帶來《Mere Mortals》，把潘朵拉的盒子神話搬進 AI 時代，由電子音樂人 Floating Points 操刀配樂，舞台上巨大螢幕投影出彷彿岩漿般的畫面，視覺相當震撼。本則整理自《衛報》與《紐約時報》報導。
voice_text: 愛丁堡藝穗節今年很熱鬧。喜劇演員巴達維，用密集的笑點講自己身為英裔埃及穆斯林、在基督教學校長大的身分拉扯，新作《Guided Detour》讓他被《周六夜現場》英國版注意到。同一段時間，舊金山芭蕾舞團帶來《Mere Mortals》，把潘朵拉的盒子神話搬進 AI 時代，配樂由電子音樂人 Floating Points 操刀，舞台上巨大螢幕投影出彷彿岩漿翻騰的畫面，視覺相當震撼。
